name: ehem. Gasthaus Bergland
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the former Gasthaus Bergland in Fließ** – a charming retreat nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** countryside.

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting, where traditional warmth meets modern comfort. Whether you're seeking relaxation after a day of hiking in the surrounding mountains or a hearty meal of **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Speckknödel**, this historic inn promises an unforgettable experience.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, Fließ offers a peaceful escape with stunning alpine views and easy access to nature’s finest trails. Come unwind, recharge, and savor the simple pleasures of rural life in the **Tirol**.
